items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: I think it was after the war he came back with Noble Sisters of the Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. I met him after he came back from Europe. I think it was after the war he came back with Noble Sisters of the Band. Yeah. That's when I first met him. Yeah. I met him. I was a guest of his in France when I was there last time.
Who did your brothers play with?
